list_child.name: lsbuilds
list_child.desc: Returns every build recorded against the repo's pipeline history. Use this when you need the full build list rather than a single record.

get_child.name: getbuild
get_child.desc: Retrieves one build by its id. It returns all fields the pipeline currently has for that build.

list_parent.name: lsrepos
list_parent.desc: Returns every repo the CI system currently tracks. Use this to enumerate repos before drilling into their builds.

get_parent.name: getrepo
get_parent.desc: Retrieves one repo by its id. It returns the repo's tracked metadata.

delete_child.name: rmbuild
delete_child.desc: Deletes a build record from the pipeline history permanently. There is no way to recover it once removed.

set_enum.name: setphase
set_enum.desc: Updates a build's phase to queued, running, passed, or failed. This overwrites whatever phase the build was previously in.

set_bool.name: flagbuild
set_bool.desc: Marks a build as flaky, meaning its result can't be trusted on its own. This is meant for builds with inconsistent pass/fail history.

set_ref.name: mvbuild
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a build record to a different repo. This is useful when a build was logged against the wrong repo.

send.name: pingowner
send.desc: Sends a text message to the repo's on-call contact about a build. This is the fastest way to get a human's attention on a build issue.

sort.sup_phrase: the build with the earliest start time
sort.ord_phrase: the build with the {ord} earliest start time
